Chin Force One: 38 chinchillas take flight. ✈️

On November 20, pilot Mike Allen flew 38 rescued chinchillas out of Norfolk, Virginia, on a flight nicknamed Chin Force One. He donated his time and covered the flight expenses.

The passenger list split at two rescue handoffs: 26 went to Alaqua Animal Refuge in Freeport, Florida, and 12 went to Pandemonium Pets in Stillwater, Oklahoma. Before takeoff, Mike’s daughter Emily helped care for the chinchillas in Norfolk. From the people who got them ready to the teams that met them on the ground, this was a family flight with a lot of helping hands.

Source: PETA, which coordinated the rescue and reported on the flight on November 25, 2026.
